schema:alternativeHeadline: Scan page 36 of Male Express, The, no. 8. Line drawing of a young man’s face with thick dark hair falling toward his forehead. Bunny stands in an open parade car, wearing a sash and raising one hand. Miss Gay San Francisco Tammy Lynn rides in a decorated parade car, with another passenger seated in front. N’ Touch muscleman poses on a street in brief shorts with a sash across his bare chest. Buzby’s decorated parade float carries several participants among balloons and a large club sign. Cable Car Girls march in short ruffled costumes along the parade route. Elmer Wilhelm of the Parade Committee stands near a large vehicle wearing glasses and a patterned shirt.
